descriptionText:
This Reverse Holo Remoraid card is a great addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. With a rarity of Common and a card type of Pokémon, this card features the character Remoraid and a striking Reverse Holo finish. The card name is also Remoraid and it is part of the Paradox Rift set. 

Perfect for fans of the game, this card is sure to impress with its unique attributes. Whether you're a collector or a player, this card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG enthusiast. Add it to your collection today!
